title: TC-TIB-017 — [Edge] Switch source inline → category after save
steps:
Preconditions: Global Option (Additional Option, source = Create new) with items, already saved

  1. Re-open the Global Option
  2. Try switching source to Select from category
  3. Switch back to Create new
expectedResult: Switching source shows a warning dialog first. After confirming, Default value is cleared; the inline items are kept in the background. Switching back to Create new restores those exact items (confirmed by dev comment).
actualResult:
Environment: staging-portal.teeinblue.com, store linh-tib-staging.myshopify.com. GO 986 (inline Additional Option, items Blue/Green/XSS-payload at the time, Crimson had been deleted in TC-015), already saved.

Observed (direct): Clicked "Select from category" — the same "Change additional option source?" warning dialog appeared, confirmed with "Switch source". Default value was cleared. Switched straight back to "Create new" (without picking a category) — warning dialog appeared again, confirmed. Result: "Additional Options (3)" reappeared with the exact same 3 items as before (Blue, Green, and the XSS-payload-named item), confirmed via DOM query of the item name links.

Conclusion (direct observation): Warning dialog appears on both switch directions, and switching back to Create new restores the exact prior inline items — matches expected result.
